learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.
Research and innovation: Ability to consult and apply good practice and safety codes in their specialty.
Research and innovation: Ability and skill to design and carry out experimental investigations, interpret results and draw conclusions in their field of study.
Practical application of engineering: Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, design, and research and their limitations in the scope of their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, technology and engineering processes and their limitations in the scope of their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Ability to apply engineering practice standards in their specialty.
Judgment formation: Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects in their specialty, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.

Communication and Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with engineers as well as people from other disciplines.
Defines the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, arguing and justifying each one, and making correct use of language, in writing.

syllabus_topics: P1 - Experimental analysis of a planar mechanism
P2 - Natural convection analysis using thermography and CFD
P3 - Application of statistical process control (SPC) in an injection molding line
P4 - Influence of assembly on the operation of mechanical assemblies
P5 - Starting modes of asynchronous motors
teaching_methods: Development, writing, and presentation of reports, memos, audiovisual material, etc. related to projects/POPBLs, carried out individually or in teams
Tutoring and monitoring sessions for training activities
Completion of exercises individually and in teams
Practical work in workshops and/or laboratories, individually or in teams
Computer simulation practices, individually and/or in teams

assessment_methods.method: Reports on exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and laboratory practices
Technical ability, involvement in the project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, documentation delivered, technical presentation and defense
Observation of student participation and attitude in the proposed training activities

assessment_rules: There are no recovery mechanisms for the assessment components.
